name: Global Botanic Garden Fund
summary: Set of small grants for botanic gardens, especially under-resourced ones in high-biodiversity areas, to drive plant conservation projects; each grant has its own purpose and eligibility.
reporting: A final report on completion: short narrative on outcomes, photos and videos where applicable, and an itemised budget against actual spending.

status.quote: Apply to the GBGF Member, ArbNet, MLA, LLNPP and GSC Grants are now closed for 2026.

access.quote: BGCI issues a call for application once per year per grant.

window.quote: BGCI issues a call for application once per year per grant.

amount.quote: Each grant awarded ranges from USD$750-10,000 (depending on the grant chosen).

reporting.quote: Successful grants will be required to submit a final report upon completion of the project with the following information: A short narrative report describing the outcome of the project using the method of evaluating described in the application Photos and videos where applicable An itemised budget vs actual
